specName: The board's Overview from the viewer's own components
request: Issue #1031, slice M (Overview): the Copilot board renders a spec's Overview with the viewer package's own dossier section components (IntentSection, ExpectationsSection, VerifiedSection, DecisionsSection, CoverageSection, OverviewTiming from packages/viewer/src/view/components/OverviewDossier.tsx), rendered to an HTML string on the canvas server at request time from a bundle esbuild builds at build time (add preact-render-to-string as a devDependency; jsx automatic with preact; one new vendor/viewer-overview.mjs). overview.mjs keeps only the board-only parts (board timing note, missing-test marks on disk, run log) and its hand-written section HTML goes. The rendered dossier keeps working inside the board's existing viewerScope wrapper and CSP (no inline style). The PR body says `Part of #1031` and `Part of #983`. The document tabs and Activity panel (slice L) are out of scope and go to a follow-up issue only after the owner agrees.
expectations: The document tabs and Activity panel
